lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Julia | Lesson 3 -- What Happened Last Weekend

listenings.text: Okay, so, our weekend. We planned everything, and then I forgot my keys inside the house. Inside. With the door closed. So we arrived at the beach house at seven and we sat outside on the step for two hours, until my uncle drove over with the spare key. Two hours. My mother did not speak to me the whole time. But then we had dinner really late, we stayed up talking until two in the morning, and honestly? I enjoyed it more than any planned weekend this year. It was the best part of the month. What did you do?

Good morning. A short note about last week's careers fair. Almost four hundred students came, which is more than we expected, and twenty-two companies took part. One thing surprised us: the longest queues were not at the big names. They were at the small companies, and several of them contacted us afterwards asking for more students. So the advice we gave you was right, for once. Now, we need something from you: there is a short survey in your email, five questions, and we need your answer before Friday. Thank you.
